dialogue.origin: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いします。

dialogue.content: That must be very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: No matter where you are...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: It must be exhausting to feel that way all the time.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そう思われ始めたきっかけとか、何か思い当たることはありますか？

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.content: Feeling like you want to disappear...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それは辛いですよね。
dialogue.content: That must be so painful.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: Has anything happened recently that made you feel this way more strongly?

dialogue.origin: 先生が脅してくるのは、怖いし不安ですよね。

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です。

dialogue.origin: はい、ありえない、、

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: But why would the teacher threaten you, I wonder?

dialogue.origin: たぶん
dialogue.content: Probably.

dialogue.origin: 世間体…。

dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: Being threatened... that must be very scary for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありえない
dialogue.content: It’s unacceptable.

dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: Yes, my friends are the same way.

dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.content: Like, 'You can't study, so you can't go to college. What are you going to do?'

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: I'm stupid, so I guess it can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: あやさん自身はそう思われているんですね。
dialogue.content: So that's how you see yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: ...So it sounds like the homeroom teacher isn't acting out of concern for you and your friends, but more to protect their own reputation and keep up appearances. Is that how it feels?

dialogue.content: Yes, that's right... That's all it is, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: The school nurse and the school counselor are no good, so probably not.

dialogue.origin: 難しいんですね。

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.content: ...Have you ever tried to stop self-harming?

dialogue.origin: 時々、思うよ
dialogue.content: Sometimes I think about it.

dialogue.origin: やめなきゃって
dialogue.content: That I should stop.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.content: - When you feel like self-harming, try wrapping a rubber band around your wrist and snapping it. - Or tie a string tightly around your wrist and leave it until the feeling subsides.

dialogue.origin: へー
dialogue.content: Huh.

dialogue.origin: ええ。

dialogue.origin: …私はあやさんの体の事が心配で書いてます。お友達についてもです。

dialogue.content: Thank you for caring.
